archigos-4.1.title: Archigos: A Data Set on Leaders 1875–2015, version 4.1
archigos-4.1.citation: Goemans, Gleditsch and Chiozza (2009), Journal of Peace Research 46(2), 269–283.
archigos-4.1.scope: Effective primary leaders of independent states in the authors' state system, observed 1875–2015; inherited spells can begin earlier. Not all monarchs or all heads of state.
archigos-4.1.reuse: Public author-hosted research download; authors request citation. No explicit open-data licence found on the download page.
limitations: Censored ends are observation cutoffs, not asserted exits.
Country codes can span regime changes; match historical atlas identity and time explicitly.
PLT/H-DATA incorporates Archigos and is not wholly independent.

review.samplingNote: Institutional checks at year precision across periods, regions and office types; includes a nonconsecutive presidency and a recorded Ghaznavid date disagreement. These samples do not establish complete rosters or exact-day accuracy.

islamic-atlas.title: Islamic Civilization Atlas — ruler and dynasty CSVs
islamic-atlas.underlyingSource: C. E. Bosworth, The New Islamic Dynasties (1996; 2004 edition cited by dataset)
islamic-atlas.scope: 830 selected entries associated with 186 dynasties; includes subordinate offices and some collective or religious leadership entries.
islamic-atlas.reuse: Repository declares CC BY-SA 4.0. Attribute the compilers and preserve the underlying Bosworth lineage.
limitations: Do not label the roster complete: many large dynasties contain only selected rulers.
Source enrichment has observed errors; no succession, religious, narrative or demographic enrichment is imported.
No Bosworth page-level citations; chapter and source row identifiers are preserved.
Restorations may be collapsed in source and require review before display.
GitHub snapshot was downloaded after Zenodo ZIP returned HTTP 504; do not claim byte-identical Zenodo release.
